faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we launch
faq.q1-answer: This fee covers complete design, development, and launch. Domain and hosting are registered in your name, meaning the site is your 100% property from day one.
faq.q2-question: What additional costs should I expect?
faq.q2-answer: Every site needs a domain (address) and hosting (server). These are external utility services. Think of it like renting office space—essential for business, but the annual cost is minimal.
faq.q3-answer: No. There are no hidden monthly maintenance fees. You pay once for the build, and the site works independently without mandatory extra costs.
faq.q4-question: When will the website be delivered?
faq.q4-answer: You will receive a fully functional, modern, mobile-responsive platform in exactly 7 calendar days.
faq.q5-answer: We offer a 'Stress-Free' package starting from 50₾/month. This covers hosting management, SSL security, daily backups, and business emails. We handle the tech so you can focus on business. This is 100% optional.
